pygame.note: the shim becomes op dictionaries; no Python or pygame at runtime

cheap_alpha.note: every layout takes the quality flag from the adaptive quality runtime

clear_caches.note: drops the gradient texture cache and the UiSkin sheet cache

_vgrad.note: vertical gradients are painted into the sheets by the real pygame helper

_shadow.note: the soft shadow ring is baked into panels.png and its expand margin

_radial.note: the only runtime radial glow is assets/art/ui/slider_glow.png

letter.note: `gap.join(list(text))`; the two older local copies stay untouched

fit_ellipsis.note: same candidate loop; `_has_glyph` becomes the ellipsis parameter

_has_glyph.note: Godot fonts report glyph coverage; the source check is a fallback pair

gradient_text.note: one `gradtext` op; `outline_text` blits it over the outline

outline_text.note: 8 outline blits when cheap_alpha(), 4 otherwise, then the body

draw_icon.note: 30 vector glyphs land in icons.png; the native side places the frame

corner_ticks.note: length 11, width 2, inset 2 defaults; eight lines

panel.note: shadow + gradient + border + ticks when cheap, flat (6, 7, 14) drop shadow otherwise

panel_solid.note: PANEL_FILL + EDGE_GOLD + gold ticks, no alpha at all

button.note: hover inflate (18, 8), glow, bevel, left accent, badge and clamped label

pill.note: eight kind rows, hover brightening (+18 / +14), radius 7

chip.note: auto width 26 + 22 icon + text + 10 + value, height 30, pill radius

section_header.note: icon, letter-spaced title, hairline and a dim underline

_dim.note: `int(c * f)` per channel, f defaults to 0.55

toggle.note: knob 18 px, label on the opposite side of the knob

slider.note: track 8 px, gold gradient fill, 11/8 px knob; also a Control node

option_cycler.note: value box width `max(110, text + 26)` clamped to `width - 66`

tab.note: active accent underline at the bottom edge, radius 8

screen_title.note: 620x150 glow, gold ornament and an optional subtitle plate
